agent_name.description: What the agent answers to in this group.

name_from_host.description: Whether the host's config chose the name, so setup need not ask.

persona_name.description:
The starter persona in use by name, or none for the plain default
or one the host wrote.

timezone.description: The group's home zone, an IANA name.

model_label.description: Which model answers for the agent and where it runs, for disclosure.

me.description: The agent's own account on each connected platform.

leads.description: Named leads, bound to platform ids and never to display names.

next_seq.description: Source of the engine's own ids, so replay mints the same ones.

hands.description: Questions the agent raised a hand on, or would have, by message.

pending_dms.description: DMs sent whose platform id has not come back yet.

extractions.description: Messages the extractor is reading, oldest first.

backfills.description: Rooms whose history is being read.

decisions.description: The decision records, never changed once written.

pending_times.description: Time expressions waiting on the resolver.

commitments.description: Who said they would do what (DESIGN.md section 11).

settlements.description: Transfers asked for by settle-up, until confirmed or disputed.

recurrences.description: Repeating events, commitments and reminders (DESIGN.md section 12).

day_of_sent.description: The last day each room had its day-of summary, as 2026-11-12.

holds.description: Actions waiting out their hold window before they leave the group.

legal_hold.description:

legal_hold_since.description: When the legal hold was turned on.

GroupId.description: A group: one memory, one charter, one SQLite file.

jobs.description: The scheduled jobs, once a lead has changed them; else the kind's.

unprompted_outbound.description: Whether a tier-1 action nobody asked for may leave the group.

chime_threshold.description: The banter score at which it may chime in, at dial 2 and 3.

digest.description: When the daily digest goes out; none for no digest.

day_of.description: The one line on a day with something on the calendar.

scores.description: Attention scores of recent messages, oldest first.

rule.description: The rule that applied, as a short phrase.
